data.raw_text:
[9:30PM] #Ijanikin #TrafficUpdate 

Good traffic movement from Abule-Ado to Under bridge Trade Fair.
Ojo Barracks to Volkswagen bus stop is moving faster, also Afolabi Ege Fruits market to Iyana Iba is good down to Iyana Iba intersection.

Okokomaiko inw Iyana Isashi is good at the moment, Cele Nisa to Ketu Aiyetoro, Iyana Era, Vespa down to Ijanikin Custom Checkpoint is good.

Lasu Igando road is good from Iyana Iba to Obadore bridge.
Return journey back to Iyana Iba under bridge is also good.

#FollowLASTMA

data.raw_text: The indecision on EDSA repairs, announced then postponed for further study, reflects a lack of vision and poor planning. Traffic congestion concerns should've been addressed first. This mirrors the controversial San Juanico Bridge repair fiasco.
